85% VERDICT
Pros: Sleek design; Stunning 3K OLED display
Cons: Expensive

HP OmniBook Ultra is a superb all-rounder laptop for work, play and entertainment. Its thin, lightweight design makes it easy to carry, while the premium construction feels sturdy enough for daily use. The display is bright and detailed, and performance remains responsive during demanding work and creative tasks.

The laptop has a stunning 3K OLED display and excellent speed and performance. Battery life, port selection and the high asking price are worth considering before buying, but this remains a capable premium Windows laptop.
